context: DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION: FOR ORAL USE ONLY Children 6–12 years of age: 2 dropperfuls (2.0 mL). Children 2–6 years of age: 1 dropperful (1.0 mL). Not recommended for children under 2. Dosages may be repeated every 4-6 hours if required for relief. Not to exceed 4 doses in 24 hours.
